notes: “Make it fill the frame” no longer saves a still picture; Crisp explains how to watch full screen or crop to fill. “Remove the crowd noise” or “the traffic noise is loud” now cleans up the sound instead of starting a video upscale, and “mute the crowd noise” no longer silences everything. “Slow down the end”, “make it 30 seconds long”, “halve the speed” and audio-sync questions get clear answers.
